adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds a direct token refresh call to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` and then persists the refreshed access token into Prisma (`prisma.credential.update(...)`). Unlike other integrations in this diff (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom/Webex/etc.) which route refreshes through the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, Salesforce never uses `refreshOAuthTokens`. Therefore, when credential sync is enabled, Salesforce will still refresh against Salesforce directly and overwrite the stored credential key instead of delegating to the parent app endpoint, matching the finding.
